description: This file is a Data Access Object (DAO) class in PHP, specifically for managing employee attachments within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for retrieving, saving, and deleting employee attachment records in the database.

classes.name: EmployeeAttachmentDao
classes.description: A DAO class responsible for handling database operations related to employee attachments, such as retrieval, saving, and deletion, within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachments
methods.description: Retrieves a list of partial employee attachments for a given employee number and screen, ordered by attachment ID.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Fetches a specific EmployeeAttachment entity based on employee number, attachment ID, and optionally screen.

methods.name: getPartialEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves a single partial employee attachment matching employee number, attachment ID, and screen.

methods.name: saveEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Persistently saves an EmployeeAttachment entity, assigning an attachment ID if not already set.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeAttachments
methods.description: Deletes multiple employee attachments based on employee number, screen, and list of attachment IDs.
